user.title: Connect to HERU
user.description: Enter the Modbus bridge details for the HERU unit. Use RTU framing if the bridge is a transparent serial tunnel rather than a Modbus TCP gateway.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the HERU Modbus bridge
error.no_heru_response: Connected to the bridge, but no HERU unit answered. Check the unit/device ID and the framing setting.
